keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Ajax 1, AZ 0. Tolu Arokodare (Ajax) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Abdellah Ouazane with a cross.
Weslley Patati (AZ) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Abdellah Ouazane (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Julian Brandt (Ajax).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Ajax. Oscar Gloukh replaces Julian Brandt because of an injury.
Mees de Wit (AZ) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lucas Rosa (Ajax).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, AZ. Wesley Hoedt replaces Wouter Goes.
Second Half begins Ajax 1, AZ 0.
Substitution, Ajax. Marcos Leonardo replaces Abdellah Ouazane.
Substitution, Ajax. Yves Bissouma replaces Davy Klaassen.
Substitution, AZ. Calvin Stengs replaces Valdemar Byskov.
Substitution, Ajax. Steven Berghuis replaces Tolu Arokodare.
Substitution, Ajax. Daley Blind replaces Jorthy Mokio.
Substitution, AZ. Mateo Chávez replaces Mees de Wit.
Substitution, AZ. Denso Kasius replaces Elijah Dijkstra.
Substitution, AZ. Bendegúz Kovács replaces Lewis Schouten.
Second Half ends, Ajax 1, AZ 0.
